title: Switching Point Optimization for Abstract Parabolic Equations
summary: This work is concerned with a switching point optimization problem governed by a semilinear parabolic equation in abstract function spaces. It is shown that the switching-point-to-control mapping is continuously Fréchet-differentiable when considered with values in the dual of Hölder continuous functions in time.
